subject: api_contracts
summary: OpenAPI adequately elevates W5 TTL expiry at standard density: POST /reservations/{holdId}/expire (operationId expire) is a first-class service-side surface with 204 restore-to-available-stock MUST semantics and 400 PreconditionError channels for missing hold and HoldNotPastTtl (no stock/hold mutation), without AuthZ as planned. W1–W4 reserve/release success and named-error paths are retained and not thinned. solidsdd-lint is pass (minors only).

findings.detail: lint: ambiguous phrase 'sufficient' in Brief scope text (unchanged by API apply)

Reusable InsufficientStockError and UnauthorizedError response components are defined but unused; operations document channels inline. Polish only—named errorType enum and expire examples already make failures distinguishable.

TTL expiry restore is stated in 204 description prose (stock increase by prior hold quantity; holdId no longer active; prefer expiresAt already in the past) without a response body returning availableStock. Adequate at standard density—checkable MUST semantics plus planned OCL posts own the restore property; stronger HTTP observation would be polish only.
